# PteroOps

> PteroOps turns Pterodactyl into an AI-operable SRE platform: persistent console intelligence, application detection, crash-loop and health diagnosis, incidents, change correlation, and policy-controlled remediation with rollback, exposed through the Model Context Protocol.

## Install (one-liner)

- macOS/Linux: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PotenFYR-Studios/PteroOps-MCP/main/scripts/install.sh | bash`
- Windows: `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PotenFYR-Studios/PteroOps-MCP/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex`

## Start here

- [Getting Started](docs/getting-started.md): complete beginner guide. Pterodactyl API keys, install, connect your AI app, first questions, troubleshooting, FAQ
- [Installation](docs/installation.md): installer flags, manual install, Docker, update/uninstall, offline installs, security notes
- [Docs Index](docs/README.md): index of every document in docs/
- Rendered docs site (same content, for humans): https://potenfyr-studios.github.io/PteroOps-MCP/, built from these markdown files via `docs/site/`

## Docs

- [Agent Guide](docs/agent-guide.md): how AI agents and LLM applications should operate PteroOps safely, investigation ladder, tool chooser, evidence/confidence semantics, do-not list
- [Capability Map](docs/capability-map.md): every capability (discovery → self-healing → code debugging) mapped to the tools that deliver it
- [Monitoring](docs/monitoring.md): Prometheus metrics, alert rules, structured logs, web console
- [MCP Reference](docs/mcp-reference.md): all 63 tools, 14 resources and 8 prompts with annotations, capability requirements and status
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): panels, keys, policy, approvals, schedules, groups, remediation, monitoring, storage, transports, environment variables
- [Integrations](docs/integrations.md): Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, custom agents, Streamable HTTP, Docker

## Status & design
